attribution: Road geometry derived from OpenStreetMap contributors; loop defined for functional testing, not for competition.
policy: This pack holds functional test fixtures, not competition venues. Every definition is provisional and timer-only until its gate profile carries a validation record. A road loop has no pit lane to identify its start/finish straight and no second independent source for a line somebody chose, so independently_validated is not reachable here: promotion must come from device capture. See docs/TRACK_DATABASE.md.

scope_exclusions.reason: This pack holds only the fixed functional test loop agreed in issue #184. No other public road is in scope, and nothing here is intended for timed competition on a public highway.

venues.source_points_note: The loop as supplied, clockwise, 943 m, measured from these points. They are the input the gates were derived from; the definition schema has no field for a route, so they are recorded here to let the derivation be rechecked.

default.derivation: Start and finish sit 30 m back along King Edward Road from the Sea Cliff Road junction, measured along the OSM centreline, because the two legs meet at the junction itself and a gate there would span both. At 30 m back the outbound leg is 26.3 m away, leaving 16.5 m between the gate end and its carriageway. Gates are 12 m: 7.62 m of road plus 2.19 m beyond each edge for lateral fix error. pit_exit faces 147.3 deg south-east-bound so the north-bound pass into the pit lane does not register.
